panel.no-media-detail: Start playback in an MPRIS-compatible media app.

auto-show.description: Show the island when playback starts or the current track changes. It stays open until dismissed. Off by default.
auto-show.label: Show on playback changes

title-limit.label: Title length
title-limit.description: Maximum number of characters of the track title shown in the bar.

click-action.label: Click action
click-action.description: What clicking the track title does: "island" toggles the music dropdown, "panel" opens the control center media tab.

show-hours.label: Show hours
show-hours.description: Show times of one hour or longer as h:mm:ss (for example 4:48:55) instead of total minutes (288:55).

audio-visualizer.label: Audio visualizer
audio-visualizer.description: Show a full-width audio-reactive wave along the bar.
